name: HaskMC
author: haskbasirat@users.noreply.github.com
description: HaskMC is an independent modified fork of Pumpkin, a Minecraft-compatible server written in Rust. NOT AN OFFICIAL MINECRAFT PRODUCT. NOT APPROVED BY OR ASSOCIATED WITH MOJANG OR MICROSOFT.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
set -eux

apk add --no-cache curl jq
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

ARCH=$(uname -m)
case "$ARCH" in
    x86_64|amd64)
        HASKMC_ARCH="X64"
        ;;
    aarch64|arm64)
        HASKMC_ARCH="ARM64"
        ;;
    *)
        echo "Unsupported architecture: $ARCH"
        exit 1
        ;;
esac

BINARY_NAME="haskmc-${HASKMC_ARCH}-Linux-musl"

if [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_URL:-}" ]; then
    URL="$DOWNLOAD_URL"
elif [ "${VERSION:-latest}" = "nightly" ]; then
    URL="https://github.com/${GITHUB_PACKAGE:-haskbasirat/HaskMC}/releases/download/nightly/${BINARY_NAME}"
elif [ "${VERSION:-latest}" = "latest" ]; then
    URL="https://github.com/${GITHUB_PACKAGE:-haskbasirat/HaskMC}/releases/latest/download/${BINARY_NAME}"
else
    URL="https://github.com/${GITHUB_PACKAGE:-haskbasirat/HaskMC}/releases/download/${VERSION}/${BINARY_NAME}"
fi

echo "Downloading HaskMC from: $URL"
curl -fsSL "$URL" -o /mnt/server/haskmc
chmod +x /mnt/server/haskmc

# Quickly start and kill server to generate initial configuration if not present
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/haskmc.toml ]; then
    timeout 2 ./haskmc || true
fi
